newsitem.title: UK: Hanson up on American buying interest.
newsitem.headline: Hanson up on American buying interest.

text.p: Shares in Hanson Plc, still in the throes of its demerger, were among the best gainers on the FTSE 100 on heavy volume amid strong buying interest in the ADRs, dealers said.
At 1549 GMT, Hanson shares were up 3-3/4p, or 3.9 percent, to 92-3/4 on heavy volume of 33.5 million shares. They were among the most actively traded shares in London.
Hanson's ADRs were up $1/8 to $-5/8 in New York.
Dealers said they did not know what was fuelling interest from U.S. investors but ADR prices were trading at a premium to the London shares.
The company's broker, ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, recently made bullish comments about the remaining units of Hanson.
Hanson's shares stand at their highest level since early October when the company initiated its four-way demerger.
